title: Repair missing CN prospective source bridge for future weeks
objective: Reproduce the W39 bridge target mismatch on W44 and inspect recurring source production in existing CN weekly workflow. Preserve the current strict validator and W44 immutable forecast. If a valid prospective source is available, repair only the existing future weekly handoff. Otherwise preserve SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.

evidence.summary: W44 readback returns BRIDGE_TARGET_WEEK_MISMATCH and excludes values.

reproduction: Read latest source and run python -m unittest -v tests.cycle_navigator.test_prospective_range_bridge. Show W39 bridge rejected as W44; trace producer in existing weekly writer before any code patch.

positive: A timely, immutable and eligible future-week W45 bridge is source-admitted by existing strict validator or correctly stays SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.
negative: W39 bridge must never be admitted for W44 or W45.
Late publication, false source hash and after-issue source changes fail closed, with guard-sensitive regression fixtures.
